note: Printer profiles for print-design. Each value is from the maker's page on verifiedOn, except where notes say otherwise. A project's design/print-profile.md and its measured fits beat these values.

printers.name: Bambu Lab P2S
printers.enclosure: enclosed; no active chamber heating, holds heat by managing air circulation
printers.materialSystem: AMS 2 Pro or AMS HT, up to 20 slots in all; first-generation AMS needs a separate buffer; AMS lite not supported per a user forum report
reachesPrinter: cloud through Bambu Studio or Bambu Handy
Developer Mode in LAN-only mode (MQTT and FTPS), unsupported by the maker
printers.notes: Wi-Fi only. Hardened steel nozzle; high-flow nozzles supported. The maker publishes no wall, overhang or tolerance numbers.

printers.name: Flashforge Adventurer 5M
printers.materialSystem: none; the multi-color system of later models is not compatible
reachesPrinter: a community-documented local HTTP API, not published by the maker
printers.notes: Open frame: no ABS or ASA. One third-party listing gives a 110 C bed; the maker's page gives 100 C, used here. Whether it prints a sliced 3MF directly is not confirmed; send G-code.

printers.name: Flashforge Adventurer 5M Pro
printers.enclosure: enclosed, with an air filter and a camera
printers.materialSystem: none; the maker states it cannot be converted to multi-color
reachesPrinter: a community-documented local HTTP API, not published by the maker
printers.notes: The enclosed sibling of the Adventurer 5M; same build volume.

printers.name: Generic FDM, 220 mm cube
printers.notes: A safe default when the printer is unknown. Replace it with the real printer before slicing.
